1.0.1.en:
First release.

• Monitor your Cummins home standby generator — through Cummins Connect Cloud, or locally over your LAN for older RS-series models.
• Start, stop and run an exercise from the device tile or a Flow.
• Alarms for faults, a missed weekly self-test, and a generator that has stopped checking in.
• Insights history on every value, a dashboard widget, and estimated power output and energy produced.

Unofficial community app — not affiliated with, endorsed by, or supported by Cummins Inc.
